name: comp-293
title: Cookie Consent Prompt
description: A non-blocking cookie notice. It explains how cookies are used, offers Accept and Decline, and carries a close icon in the corner.
use: A site must collect cookie consent without blocking the page, as a corner card rather than a full dialog.
avoid: Nothing is wired: the buttons and close X have no handlers, so saving a choice and dismissing are on you.
a11y: Keyboard reachable with a labelled close button, but the card has no live-region or landmark role for screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card with a thin border and soft shadow. A bold headline with a cookie emoji sits above two grey lines of copy, with a white Accept button and an outlined Decline button at the lower left and a small X at the top right.
behaves: The card holds still. Accept, Decline and the close icon react to hover and press with fill and opacity changes; in the clip the card never actually closes.
customise: Headline, copy and button labels are fixed in the file, so reuse means editing the source; it takes no props and the controls carry no handlers.
weight: light: A static card with three buttons and one small close icon; no runtime loop.
